issues: 没有导出时长常量，工作台从源码抓到 14f，只渲染出填墙前的空底，九宫格一格都没亮
九格里有两格是灰底上放一张小卡的"灰卡格"，其余裁切偏移随手取，多数格子切在卡片之间的空隙
整面墙是亮灰底 + 白格 + 黑描边，九格同一明度，墙面没有节奏
入格 3f 缩放是线性插值，吞屏时其余格不受影响，中心格放大缺纵深
吞屏结束后仍是 0.3125x 缩略页经 3.28 倍 transform 放大，作为收尾满屏页面字边不可靠
changes: 补 GRID_FLASH_MOSAIC_DURATION = 140（铺垫 25f + 填墙 19f + 呼吸 14f + 吞屏 14f + 真静止 68f）；每 2f 一格、h(i) 乱序、1.18→1、3.28x 吞屏全部不变
八个裁切全部对准真实模块（Active users / Revenue / Sessions 指标卡居中留 35px 边、Quarterly goals、Deploys 热力图、三段列表行），去掉灰卡格
墙改为带色相的深色 Backdrop + 12px 暗缝，格子亮 / 暗两套皮肤棋盘交错（暗格用 FakeDashboard tone="dark"），描边与缝同色系深墨
入格缩放改 cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)（首帧就砸到位附近）；吞屏时其余格同步压暗 42% 退后、中心格加大投影
吞屏终帧摘罩：满屏页面按终帧几何（缩略页原点经 3.28 绕屏心放大）用 CSS zoom 直出，网格与描边彻底卸载，叠暗角 + 颗粒
issuesEn: No exported duration; the workbench grabbed 14f from the source, so only the empty pre-fill background rendered and no cell ever lit
Two of the nine cells were 'grey cards' (a small card on grey), and the remaining crop offsets were arbitrary, mostly landing in gaps between cards
The whole wall was light grey with white cells and black borders, all at one brightness, so it had no rhythm
The 3f pop-in scale was a linear interpolation, and the other cells ignored the centre zoom, so it had no depth
After the zoom the final full-screen page was still a 0.3125x thumbnail magnified 3.28x by transform, so text sharpness on the hold was unreliable
changesEn: Added GRID_FLASH_MOSAIC_DURATION = 140 (25f lead-in + 19f fill + 14f breath + 14f zoom + 68f true hold); 2f per cell, h(i) shuffle, 1.18→1 pop and the 3.28x zoom unchanged
All eight crops now frame real modules (Active users / Revenue / Sessions cards centred with 35px margins, Quarterly goals, the Deploys heatmap, three list-row bands); the grey-card cells are gone

The wall sits on a tinted dark Backdrop with 12px dark gutters, cells alternate light and dark skins in a checkerboard (dark cells use FakeDashboard tone="dark"), and borders use the same dark ink as the gutters
Pop-in scale uses cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) so it lands almost immediately; during the zoom the other cells darken 42% and recede while the centre cell's shadow deepens

The last zoom frame unmasks to a full-screen page rendered with CSS zoom at the exact end geometry (thumbnail origin scaled 3.28x around centre), dropping the grid and borders, with vignette and grain
